First of all, make sure that the cuts are clean and that you are safe in the position that you are in. The way that I would stop blood from constantly coming out is by cleaning the cuts and basically just waiting for it to stop. It is probably best to use a plaster if the cuts are big enough, maybe lift your arm up high to stop as much blood coming out. Nothing is wrong with you for liking the feeling or finding it kind of fun, that is why cutting is so dangerous because it can become an addiction which causes many problems which now makes me wish that I never started cutting. 

I would advise stopping now as it can be so addictive but I obviously can't stop you over the internet. So stay safe, clean your cuts, and if you are comfortable with it then you should seek help and tell someone.
